entries.name: computeCase
entries.what: One call that computes everything the headline needs from a case: the overlaid model, headline, canonical payback and NPV, phase scope and glass ceiling. The UI reads it through useCaseResult(), memoised per document.

entries.name: makeCtx
entries.what: The seam. Turns the document into a typed, immutable context (inputs, working artefacts, rate card). The calculation never touches the DOM or the store.

entries.name: modelRaw
entries.what: The flat annual model: ceiling, weights, supervision, run cost, token cost, verification tax, loops — before any curve is applied.

entries.name: model
entries.what: modelRaw() plus the Time-Engine curve overlay: under a non-legacy curve the annual arrays are replaced by the engine's own yearly sums and samples.

entries.name: engineNow
entries.what: The standard entry point: an engine for the active curve, always built from the RAW model (never the overlaid one, which would apply the curve twice).

entries.name: paybackMonthsCanonical
entries.what: THE single canonical payback month (1-based) or null — same one-source-of-truth discipline as NPV.

entries.name: npvCanonical
entries.what: THE single canonical NPV: monthly-discounted at the case discount rate (MODEL.CASE.discountRate, else 8 %).

entries.name: phaseScopeOf
entries.what: Phase-scope averages (automatable share, supervision, effort) of the selected artefacts.

entries.name: timeFor
entries.what: Builds a FRESH engine for {mode, curveModelId, model}. No caching: the engine is immutable, invalidation is by reconstruction.

entries.name: buildK
entries.what: Freezes the constants of one engine instance (ramps, curve anchors, rates, costs, horizon) from a context and a model.

entries.name: makeEngine
entries.what: Memoised monthly rows and their annual aggregation over a frozen kernel.

entries.name: monthAt
entries.what: One monthly row (adoption, maturity level, vFTE, costs, net savings). Throws outside 1..horizon.

entries.name: months
entries.what: All monthly rows.

entries.name: cumulativeAt
entries.what: Cumulative net savings at month t.

entries.name: payback
entries.what: First month where the cumulative net savings turn non-negative, or null.

entries.name: npv
entries.what: Monthly-discounted NPV of the net savings.

entries.name: roi
entries.what: Net savings over the horizon divided by the setup total.

entries.name: year
entries.what: One annual row, aggregated from the months (the annual view is a reduce over months, never a parallel calculation).

entries.name: years
entries.what: Every annual row 1..horizon. The last one is the canonical end-of-horizon read (legacy teEndYearRow()).

entries.name: milestones
entries.what: Adoption thresholds, maturity-level crossings, first agent vFTE and payback, in month order.

entries.name: headline
entries.what: Payback, NPV at 8 %, ROI and total savings of the horizon.
